prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same small shop entrance at night (the glass door held open to a dark parking lot, cream walls with red trim, a black floor mat), the same handheld phone camera, framing, timing and moves. Replace the walker in [Video 1] with the person from [Image 1]. The ONLY change: the man with the big ginger 1970s hair who walks in through the door is now the person in [Image 1], a real human.

The walker = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo). Keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, build and outfit. If [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest of the outfit so it matches naturally. NO big ginger hair, NO thin moustache, NO green velvet jacket, NO mustard turtleneck and NO cream flared trousers unless [Image 1] shows them. The same real person in every frame, from the small figure outside to the close-up at the end, so their friends recognize them at once. Never morph, never drift back to the original walker's face, never a stylized cartoon face.
If [Image 1] shows an animal, the walker is that animal walking upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.
A stranger standing beside the doorway holds the door wide open: the white-haired door holder, who stays exactly as in the video.

The walker does the pimpwalk entrance exactly as in [Video 1]: exaggerated swagger, slow lean-back strut, chin up, shoulders rolling, one arm swinging loose, a low bounce on the knees on the step through the doorway, cool confident face, and walks through the held door toward the camera.

One continuous handheld take, no cuts, matching [Video 1] second by second:
[0-3.5s]: the door holder grooves beside the open glass door; outside, the walker strolls from the car toward the door.
[3.5-5s]: the walker steps through the held door, knees bent, leaning back, a small red card in one hand, a small black bag in the other.
[5-10s]: a deep, slow, low strut toward the camera, knees bent almost to a squat, shoulders rolling, head bobbing, hair bouncing.
[10-12s]: still low, the walker leans in close to the camera, one hand near the floor, then rises.
[12-15s]: the walker stands tall close to the camera, chin up, fans the face with the red card and poses; the door holder grooves behind.

The walker copies every move of the original at the same moment and speed. Real live-action footage, clear facial features.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the walker's shoulders. A face never appears on hands, knees, clothes or the door. Two arms, two legs, five fingers on each hand. No extra people. The door and shop front are completely blank: no lettering, no decals, no signage, no logos anywhere. No text, no watermark.
